note: Plain-English jobs a fresh install's agent may be handed. query = what an agent would type into tool search; prompt = what the live eval hands claude (no tool names); expect = the tool that does the job; external = also run for an external write-scope token. Read by tests/python/mcp/test_mcp_discovery_keywords.py and scripts/mcp/discovery_eval.py.

jobs.prompt: Which agent sessions are running on this computer right now? List them for me.

jobs.prompt: Show me the latest terminal output of the agent session whose tmux name is cloude_demo.

jobs.prompt: Send the message "please run the tests" to the agent session whose tmux name is cloude_demo.
